method: Compare four first-party help routes using separate columns for copying media, exporting audience relationships, accessing consented sales records and retaining historic engagement. Unknown is null rather than no.
population: Account-owner capabilities of YouTube, Twitch, TikTok and Vimeo OTT; no observed migration cohort or private records

routes.route: Owner downloads eligible uploaded videos with Studio or Google Takeout.
restrictions: Downloaded MP4 copies are not necessarily original editing projects or a complete channel archive.
Brand Account transfer is internal, carries possible deletion and eligibility risks, and is not a transfer to Twitch, TikTok or Vimeo.
Subscribers and aggregated returning viewer reports are not a consented external customer contact list.

routes.route: Enabled past broadcasts can be downloaded individually or exported directly to a linked YouTube account.
restrictions: Past Broadcast storage must have been enabled before streaming; a past broadcast is not guaranteed to exist.
Twitch's Help says single-video download/export rather than built-in bulk downloading; muted audio may stay muted.
Exporting a video to YouTube does not transfer followers, live subscriptions, Bits, comments or monetization approval.
Vertical/2K variants may expire sooner than the remaining horizontal/1080p video.

routes.route: Account holder may request an account data download through TikTok settings; specific video/audience transfer capability is not validated here.
restrictions: The request workflow is not a documented platform-to-platform transfer mechanism.
The public help snippet reviewed here does not establish that TikTok exports all media files, subscribers, recommendation data or contact consent.
No inference about global completeness or country-specific access is made.

routes.route: Authorized seller may export Customers and Transactions CSVs, including customer status and marketing opt-in fields.
restrictions: A customer CSV is sensitive account data; this research records only the publicly documented schema, not real customers.
Marketing opt-in must be respected; having billing records is not universal marketing authorization.
A CSV export does not prove automatic transfer of active subscriptions, app-store billing agreements or buyer logins to another platform.
Video asset export and historic recommendations are not established by this customer-management help document.

required_cost_observations: Creator's own asset/archive preparation time and missing media
Rights/license checks before reuse across hosts
Replacement channel onboarding, payout eligibility and payment delays
Viewer/customer communications with opt-in permissions where applicable
Receipts and labor before and after switch, including zeros, abandoned attempts and churn
known_asymmetry: Twitch documents copying/exporting selected recorded media to YouTube; Vimeo OTT documents an authorized seller customer CSV with marketing consent flags; neither proves native migration of followers or paying subscriptions.
privacy_rule: Only document public feature rules. Never export or publish actual customer CSVs, follower identities, account tokens or payment data.
